requests.purpose: Verify original named research-dataset identity, DOI/version/license and documentary file manifest without downloading any file.

requests.requires: The first record explicitly links this exact paper DOI or its original-source citation; otherwise do not guess a match.
requests.purpose: Primary paper identity and article terms only; suppress abstract/model-performance content.

requests.requires: Paper identity verified in preceding metadata.
requests.purpose: Identify exact legitimate open-access primary article XML identifier; no broad search.

requests.requires: Exactly one DOI-matching open-access PMCID; stop if absent or ambiguous.
requests.purpose: Bounded primary source for documentary schema/methods only; no scientific result or performance extraction.

transport: Ordinary HTTPS GET,30s timeout,no redirects,no retries,credentialsfalse. Preserve first denial/error and stop the affected route; no mirror, bypass or additional endpoints.
metadata_projection: Selected DOI/title/date/version/license/creator-name/references and file name/size/hash/URL fields only. No record files, descriptions or numerical model/performance content displayed. URLs are documentary literals, never followed beyond the four explicitly scoped requests.
primary_xml_projection: Whole article XML is machine-read and can include target-bearing tables or published model performance. Before any researcher prose display, inventory section titles and table captions only with numeric tokens masked. Then limit documentary prose to direct paragraphs of Methods/Data Records and explicitly named computational/schema subsections; do not recursively admit all descendants. Exclude Results, Technical Validation, performance/accuracy/benchmark discussion, figures and all table cells by default. A table may be inspected only after its caption identifies it as a field/unit schema, with numeric example columns suppressed. No material/molecule target examples or model-accuracy values extracted. No JavaScript, external entities or source code execution.
exposure: Full metadata and (if obtained) whole primary article container machine exposure is declared. Researcher output is documentary metadata, numeric-redacted methods/schema prose and allowed schema labels/units; not a global untouched-source claim. Existing project historical exposures remain preserved.
forbidden: Any numeric dataset/XYZ/CSV/archive or model/record acquisition
Old exposed targets or Li/Dryad alternative access
Joins, fits, candidate criteria, target thresholds, allocations, benchmark admission
rights: Distinguish primary dataset's explicit terms from article/software terms, and current version metadata from verified data bytes. No unrestricted use inferred from public access.
decision: Compare schema, documented pairing, source/molecular-family grouping roles and rights before recommending any next acquisition. Report actual usable counts/conditions/overlap as unknown unless documentary metadata establishes only an advertised statement. No actual benchmark chosen.
